messages:
Maria P.: heads-up: seeing recurring OOMs on shard-cache-prod over the last 48h, attaching a heatmap and a couple of sample logs. :eyes:
Maria P.: heatmap -> https://internal.redwood/graphs/heatmap/3741234567 (shard agg, 1m bin)
Jordan W.: can you drop the flamegraph or a sample request id? my hunch is KV residency growth from large prefix scans.
Lee (runtime): saw similar surge last week on the same shard set. symptoms looked like slab fragmentation + delayed eviction.
Sasha: ops-bot clustered INC-4792/INC-4795/INC-4801 to this thread — rolling them into single follow-up.
ops-bot: Incident cluster created: cluster/oom-kv-3741 (linked incidents: INC-4792, INC-4795, INC-4801)
Anil: propose a short remediation plan: (1) profile heap+jemalloc, (2) enable conservative GC/frag compaction on canary, (3) apply soft limits, (4) measure eviction effectiveness.
Maria P.: suggested owners: Jordan -> profiling, Lee -> eviction/GC + runbook, Sasha -> ops coordination. ok?
Jordan W.: ack. I'll run jemalloc stats + perf. target: initial profile uploaded by EOD today.
Lee (runtime): I'll prepare an eviction-policy canary (evict on prefix-age + size), and draft a frag-gc runbook. aiming for a 48h canary window.
Sasha: ops will reserve a canary window and capacity, tentative slot: 2026-03-02 10:00-12:00 UTC :calendar:
Anil: short mitigation: bump kv soft_limit to 85% on canary nodes and enable slab_compact=on. we'll monitor tail latencies.
Maria P.: ops command example for compacting slab (example only):
```sudo sh -c 'echo 1 > /proc/slab_compact'```
Jordan W.: profiler command I'm using:
```LD_PRELOAD=libjemalloc.so jeprof --alloc_objects ./server /tmp/jeprof.out && scp /tmp/jeprof.out ops:/tmp/profiles/3741```
Jordan W.: uploading initial profile to /tmp/profiles/3741 now. found high alloc rate tied to prefix_merge code path.
Sasha: tagging logs/alerts with #oom-cluster-3741 and adding timeline to the postmortem follow-ups doc.
Sasha: concise action-items (I'll own the tracking doc):
- Jordan W.: upload profile + PR with hotspot notes (due 3741235200)
- Lee (runtime): eviction canary + runbook draft (due 3741238800)
- Anil: apply mem cgroup soft-limit change on canary during window (ops)
- Maria P.: consolidate incidents & create timeline (due 3741236800)
Jordan W.: quick observation: KV resident set jumps after long-running prefix queries that return large key sets — likely a cache growth pattern, not a single leak. :mag:
Lee (runtime): params to try for frag-gc: --frag-gc-threshold=0.6 and --slab-compaction-interval=60s ; also prototyping per-shard slab pools.
Maria P.: per-shard pools might increase OOM isolation at cost of utilization. track cost tradeoffs.
Anil: during canary we'll also enable enhanced jemalloc stats (jemalloc.opt.stats_print=true).
Sasha: I'll create a weekly recurring sync for this cluster until stable. first recurring: 2026-03-05 16:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: canary/kv-evict-policy-0.2 at 3741236000
Maria P.: thanks all — sync at EOD for initial findings. please paste links to profiles and any quick mitigations in this thread. :thumbsup:
